class.name: LocalGIVolume3D
class.brief_description: Local probe-grid GI volume. Phase 7 classifies probes embedded in static or dynamic geometry as inactive before shading interpolation.
class.description: A volume that owns local static/dynamic BVH transport and a regular probe grid. Phase 1 collects visible [constant GeometryInstance3D.GI_MODE_STATIC] meshes that intersect the volume, converts their triangles into volume local space, and builds a CPU static BVH. Phase 2 tracks visible [constant GeometryInstance3D.GI_MODE_DYNAMIC] rigid meshes and rebuilds a separate CPU dynamic BVH only when a relevant transform, mesh, or membership change is detected. Phase 3 uploads both trees to GPU storage buffers and traces rays with a software compute shader, then chooses the nearest hit. Phase 4 builds a regular probe grid in volume local space and traces a deterministic spherical ray set from each probe. Phase 5 evaluates direct lights at each hit, applies a Lambertian BRDF, and integrates incoming radiance into per-probe spherical irradiance. Phase 6 stores per-ray distance mean and second moment, then samples final indirect diffuse with nearest-8 trilinear interpolation, a front-facing normal weight, and Chebyshev visibility. Phase 7 classifies probes as inactive when the majority of six axis-aligned first hits indicate the origin is inside static or dynamic geometry, excludes them from shading weights, and renormalizes the remaining probes. Inactive probes are not relocated. Temporal, multi-bounce, and [code]GlobalIndirectCache[/code] are not implemented yet. [b]Note:[/b] LocalGI is designed to stay decoupled from HDDAGI internals. External indirect light will enter later only through a [code]GlobalIndirectCache[/code] adapter. Missed rays currently contribute zero.

method.name: classify_probes
method.description: Classifies each probe as active or inactive by tracing six axis-aligned rays against the static and dynamic CPU BVHs. A probe is inactive when the majority of first hits indicate the origin is inside a solid. Dynamic coverage is temporary: a later [method update_dynamic] plus [method classify_probes] restores probes after the object leaves. This method does not relocate probes.

method.name: is_probe_active
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] when probe [param index] is active after [method classify_probes] or [method compute_one_bounce]. Unclassified probes are treated as active.

method.name: get_active_probe_count
method.description: Number of probes currently classified as active. Returns [code]0[/code] before the first classification.

method.name: get_probe_active_states
method.description: Per-probe active flags in the same order as [method get_probe_positions]. [code]1[/code] is active, [code]0[/code] is inactive.

method.name: compute_one_bounce
method.description: Collects visible non-negative scene lights, traces every probe ray on the CPU, evaluates direct irradiance with BVH shadow rays, and stores Lambertian outgoing radiance as incoming probe radiance. Each probe's spherical irradiance is [code](4π / rays_per_probe) * sum(incoming radiance)[/code]. Classifies probes after integration. Returns [code]true[/code] when at least one probe was integrated. If [param from_node] is omitted, the walk uses the same root as [method bake].

method.name: get_collected_light_count
method.description: Number of lights captured by the last [method compute_one_bounce].

method.name: get_mean_probe_irradiance
method.description: Average spherical irradiance across all probes after [method compute_one_bounce].

method.name: get_probe_irradiance
method.description: Spherical irradiance stored at probe [param index].

method.name: get_probe_irradiances
method.description: Spherical irradiance for every probe, in the same order as [method get_probe_positions].

method.name: get_probe_ray_distance_mean
method.description: Hit distance along one probe ray after [method compute_one_bounce]. Missed rays store the volume diagonal.

method.name: get_probe_ray_distance_second_moment
method.description: Squared hit distance along one probe ray. With a single sample this equals [code]mean * mean[/code], so Chebyshev visibility is a hard occlusion test until temporal accumulation is added.

method.name: get_probe_ray_radiance
method.description: Incoming radiance along one probe ray after [method compute_one_bounce]. Missed rays are black.

method.name: sample_indirect_irradiance
method.description: Interpolated indirect irradiance at a point in volume local space. Uses the nearest eight probes, trilinear weights, a front-facing normal weight, and Chebyshev visibility. Inactive probes are excluded before renormalization. Returns black before [method compute_one_bounce], when every neighboring probe is inactive or occluded, or when the weight sum is zero.

method.name: sample_indirect_radiance
method.description: Lambertian outgoing radiance [code]albedo / π * sample_indirect_irradiance(position, normal)[/code] in volume local space.

method.name: sample_shading
method.description: Full 8-probe sample used by final shading. The dictionary contains [code]irradiance[/code], [code]weight_sum[/code], [code]visibility_mean[/code], [code]finite[/code], and [code]corners[/code]. Each corner dictionary contains [code]index[/code], [code]trilinear_weight[/code], [code]normal_weight[/code], [code]visibility_weight[/code], [code]weight[/code], and [code]active[/code]. Inactive probes contribute zero weight and are omitted from the renormalized sum.

method.name: has_one_bounce
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] when [method compute_one_bounce] has produced a current probe field.

method.name: probe_irradiance_is_finite
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] when one-bounce results exist and contain no NaN or Inf channels.

method.name: build_probes
method.description: Rebuilds the regular probe grid and shared spherical directions from [member size], [member probe_spacing], and [member rays_per_probe]. Positions stay in volume local space, so moving or rotating this node does not change the local layout.

method.name: bake
method.description: Collects eligible static meshes under [param from_node], converts triangles into volume local space, and rebuilds the CPU static BVH. If [param from_node] is omitted, collection starts at the highest non-Viewport ancestor so sibling scene geometry is included. Moving this node after baking does not rebuild the BVH by itself. In the editor, [method is_static_dirty] is polled while a debug mode is active so newly created or moved static meshes rebake automatically.

method.name: compare_cpu_gpu_rays
method.description: Traces the same rays on CPU and GPU and returns mismatch counts plus max distance/normal error. The dictionary contains [code]ray_count[/code], [code]hit_mismatch[/code], [code]nearest_mismatch[/code], [code]identity_mismatch[/code], [code]max_distance_error[/code], [code]max_normal_error[/code], and [code]passed[/code].

method.name: get_baked_triangle_count
method.description: Number of static triangles stored by the last [method bake]. Returns [code]0[/code] before the first bake.

method.name: get_dynamic_contributor_count
method.description: Number of dynamic contributors captured by the last [method update_dynamic]. Returns [code]0[/code] before the first update.

method.name: get_dynamic_rebuild_count
method.description: How many times the CPU dynamic BVH has been rebuilt. Stationary contributors do not increment this value.

method.name: get_dynamic_triangle_count
method.description: Number of dynamic triangles stored by the last [method update_dynamic]. Returns [code]0[/code] before the first update.

method.name: get_probe_count
method.description: Number of probes produced by the last [method build_probes]. Returns [code]0[/code] before the first build.

method.name: get_probe_directions
method.description: Shared deterministic unit directions used by every probe. The array length equals [member rays_per_probe] after [method build_probes].

method.name: get_probe_position
method.description: Local-space position of the probe at [param index].

method.name: get_probe_positions
method.description: All probe positions in volume local space, ordered X slowest then Y then Z.

method.name: get_probe_ray_budget
method.description: Exact ray count [code]probe_count * rays_per_probe[/code] for the current grid.

method.name: get_probe_resolution
method.description: Integer probe counts along local X, Y, and Z. Each axis is at least 2.

method.name: intersect_gpu_ray
method.description: Uploads the current CPU BVHs if needed and traces one ray on the GPU in volume local space. The returned dictionary matches [method intersect_ray].

method.name: intersect_gpu_rays
method.description: Traces a batch of rays on the GPU. Each result dictionary matches [method intersect_ray].

method.name: intersect_dynamic_ray
method.description: Traces a ray against the CPU dynamic BVH in volume local space. The returned dictionary contains [code]hit[/code], [code]distance[/code], [code]position[/code], [code]normal[/code], and [code]triangle_index[/code].

method.name: intersect_ray
method.description: Traces a ray against both CPU BVHs in volume local space and returns the nearest hit. Equal distances prefer the static hit.

method.name: intersect_static_ray
method.description: Traces a ray against the baked static BVH in volume local space. The returned dictionary contains [code]hit[/code], [code]distance[/code], [code]position[/code], [code]normal[/code], and [code]triangle_index[/code].

method.name: is_gpu_available
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] when a local RenderingDevice and the BVH compute pipeline can be created.

method.name: is_static_dirty
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] when a relevant static transform, mesh, volume bounds, or membership change has not yet been rebuilt into the CPU static BVH.

method.name: is_dynamic_dirty
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] when a relevant dynamic transform, mesh, volume bounds, or membership change has not yet been rebuilt into the CPU dynamic BVH.

method.name: upload_gpu
method.description: Uploads the current static and dynamic CPU BVHs to GPU storage buffers. Returns [code]false[/code] when GPU tracing is unavailable.

method.name: trace_probe_rays
method.description: Builds the probe grid if needed, then traces every probe ray against the uploaded GPU BVHs. Falls back to CPU tracing when GPU is unavailable. Returns [code]true[/code] when the ray set was traced.

method.name: update_dynamic
method.description: Collects visible [constant GeometryInstance3D.GI_MODE_DYNAMIC] meshes under [param from_node] and rebuilds the CPU dynamic BVH only if [method is_dynamic_dirty] is [code]true[/code]. Returns [code]true[/code] when a rebuild happened. If [param from_node] is omitted, collection uses the same root walk as [method bake].

members.member: Debug visualization mode. Phase 3 uses [constant DEBUG_STATIC_BVH_HIT], [constant DEBUG_DYNAMIC_BVH_HIT], [constant DEBUG_RAY_HIT_MISS], [constant DEBUG_HIT_NORMAL], and [constant DEBUG_HIT_DISTANCE] to draw GPU/CPU ray hits. Phase 4 uses [constant DEBUG_PROBE_POSITIONS] and [constant DEBUG_SELECTED_PROBE_RAYS]. Phase 5 uses [constant DEBUG_RAW_PROBE_RADIANCE] and [constant DEBUG_PROBE_IRRADIANCE]. Phase 6 uses [constant DEBUG_VISIBILITY], [constant DEBUG_PROBE_WEIGHTS], and [constant DEBUG_FINAL_LOCAL_GI] to draw a mid-height shading slice. Phase 7 uses [constant DEBUG_PROBE_CLASSIFICATION] to color probes green when active and red when inactive.
Probe index used by [constant DEBUG_SELECTED_PROBE_RAYS]. [code]-1[/code] selects the center probe.
Enables multi-bounce local GI in later phases. Unused in Phase 0.
Target regular probe spacing in volume local meters. Each axis uses [code]max(2, floor(size / spacing))[/code] cell-centered probes.
Number of deterministic spherical directions generated for every probe.
Axis-aligned volume size in local meters. The volume is centered on the node origin.
Intended temporal EMA hysteresis. Unused in Phase 0.
Intended fraction of probes updated per frame. Unused in Phase 0.

constants.constant: Draws debug rays and shows only static BVH hits.
Draws debug rays and shows only dynamic BVH hits.
Draws debug rays colored by hit or miss, plus a short hit normal.
Colors hit rays by the stored triangle normal.
Colors hit rays by intersection distance.
Draws a sphere at every local probe position. The selected probe is larger.
Draws the selected probe and its GPU-traced spherical rays. Hits are green; misses are dim.
Colors the selected probe's rays by incoming one-bounce radiance.
Colors each probe sphere by the actual incoming radiance in that direction. The side facing a red wall should read red; missed directions stay black. Values are not remapped.
Draws a mid-height slice of shading samples colored by mean Chebyshev visibility of the eight surrounding probes. White is visible; black is occluded.
Draws a mid-height slice colored by the unnormalized 8-probe weight sum after trilinear, normal, and visibility terms.
Draws a mid-height slice colored by interpolated local indirect irradiance. Values are not remapped.
Draws every probe sphere colored by classification. Green is active (free space). Red is inactive (embedded in static or dynamic geometry).
